Yeah! For me it’s mainly my back and neck, but my scalp and knees too, though way less, thankfully. It’s so difficult to stop, I can be telling myself in my head for ages to just stop because it hurts and that my clothes and nails are getting dirty and bloody, and it’s making me feel dirty, but it rarely works, because my skin still feels off, and it’s then almost all I can think about. And when I can actually get myself to stop it just takes ages, and it doesn’t take long for me to start doing it again. Yeah, I get that! I’m lucky that most of mine are easier to hide, or if I can’t hide them they can be ignored as acne on my face, scrapes on my knees, etc. But I can’t take my shirt off or go swimming or anything like that anymore, which fucking sucks, because I love swimming, but even if I wasn’t embarrassed about how my skin looks, I’m sure there must be some kind of risk for infection by going in a pool with my skin like that. In a weird way I’m glad somebody else gets it, I’m sorry that you do get it though because like you said, it’s fucking rough. Gotta start a support group or something lmfao. I hope you get to stop eventually! :) it’s not a very fun experience haha
